claims.value: FL_repN/MAL_repN = biological replicate N of each fraction; PsbO_band_* = PsbO gel band of each fraction; 2D_Lumen_N = free-lumen 2D gel spot N.
claims.evidence: Paper: four independent biological replicates of FL and MAL fractions; Table S3 lists proteins in 2D CN/SDS-PAGE spots from free lumen; Table S4 the PsbO band.

claims.value: Q Exactive DDA; trypsin; DTT/IAA; Mascot via PD 2.2, 10 ppm / 0.02 Da; Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M, Protein N-term Acetyl, Phospho STY variable.
claims.evidence: Sample-processing and data-processing protocols and paper Methods.

limitations: HCD dissociation is assumed from the Q Exactive platform (MS2 resolution 17500); the text does not name the dissociation method.
Developmental stage is `not available` for rows (plants are 6 weeks old per protocol; recorded as not available in line with sibling Turku plant SDRFs).
2D_Lumen spots and the PsbO bands have no independent replicate structure; each is biological replicate 1 of its own source. The FL/MAL rows of the same replicate number are separate sources.
